name: @susurration/installer
description: One-shot installer: detects your AI IDEs, wires up Susurration MCP, installs the agent daemon, and starts it. Run via npx after registering at https://susurration.xyz.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile bin/susu-installer.mjs --target node --format esm --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node'
